## Where did applicants come from—and who received grants? {#yearly-origins}

The **receiving-country dropdown above** controls this section. Choose a year to see the country's annual grant rates and two different Top 3 lists. Origins are ranked by **counts**, not by the highest percentage: one list shows where reported applications originated, the other where grant recipients originated.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
originYearData = FileAttachment("data/origin-year-explorer.json").json()
originCards = import((await FileAttachment("assets/origin-year-cards.js").url()) + "?v=2")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof originYear = Inputs.select(Array.from({length:data.metadata.year_to_available-data.metadata.year_from+1},(_,i)=>data.metadata.year_from+i),{label:"Applications and grants year",value:data.metadata.year_to_available,format:String})
viewof grantDefinition = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Refugee status only","refugee"],["Any protection: refugee status + other protection","protection"]]),{label:"Rank grant recipients by",value:"refugee"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const group=originYearData.groups[selected.iso]?.[String(originYear)];
  const panel=document.createElement("div");panel.className="origin-year-selection";
  const title=document.createElement("h3");title.textContent=selected.name+" · "+originYear;
  const summary=document.createElement("p");summary.className="explorer-status origin-year-summary";
  if (!group) summary.textContent="No application or decision records are available for this country and year.";
  else {
    const rate=grants.rates(group.summary);
    const number=value=>value==null?"Unavailable":value.toLocaleString("en-GB");
    summary.textContent="Applications: "+number(group.summary.applications)+" · Decisions: "+number(group.summary.decisions)+" · Refugee recognition rate: "+percent(rate.refugee_rate)+" · Total protection rate: "+percent(rate.protection_rate)+" · Closure share: "+percent(rate.closed_share)+".";
  }
  panel.append(title,summary,originCards.cards(group,originYearData.origins,grantDefinition,grants));return panel;
}
```

Refugee and total-protection rates use substantive decisions; closure shares use all recorded decisions. Rates are unavailable where outcome counts do not reconcile to a positive decision total. Flags identify the **recorded country of origin**, not a verification of citizenship; unknown origins have no flag. Applications and grants are different annual flows: recipients may have applied in earlier years. Persons and cases are combined without conversion, and ranks do not estimate an individual's chance of success. Ties are resolved by origin code.

This section uses the exact source ZIP behind the country explorer, with independently checked country-year totals. Its year selection is separate from the closure-comparison year below.

Flag artwork is bundled locally from [FlagCDN](https://flagcdn.com/); names and ISO codes remain visible alongside each flag.
